facilityType: A premier health and rehabilitation center
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a leading health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This vital leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $60,000 - $75,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to exceptional patient care. If you are a Registered Nurse with a passion for leadership and a desire to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

As an ADON, you will play a crucial role in supporting the Director of Nursing, overseeing daily nursing operations, and ensuring the highest standards of care for our residents. You will contribute to staff development, maintain regulatory compliance, and foster a positive and supportive environment for both staff and residents. This is an excellent opportunity for an RN looking to advance their career in a dynamic and rewarding setting.
requirements: Previous experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal regulations governing skilled nursing facilities
Ability to effectively manage and mentor nursing staff
